en.html:
The crossing gave us no trouble. We reached Urayasu, took the bus to Funabashi as planned, and continued along the coast on foot.

Narashino, then Mihama... Beyond that was Oyumi, right at the base of the Bousou Peninsula.

Cold sea wind, but the sun was doing enough to make it bearable. So far, a peaceful journey. Shogunate vehicles kept passing us. None had given us any particular trouble.

Perhaps we would reach our destination without incident.

...Yes. Perhaps let the journey finish before certifying it.

ja.html:
平穏な航海の末、浦安へ到着した。
　予定通りバスに乗って船橋へ。そこから海岸沿いを
歩く。

　習志野から美浜へ……
　丁度房総半島の付け根にある小弓はその先だ。

　潮風は冷えるが、日差しのお陰で耐えかねる程でも
ない。まずまず平穏な道行だった。
　しばしば幕軍の車両と行き違うが、特にトラブルと
いう程のことはなくやり過ごせている。

　どうやら何事もなく目的地へ着けそうだ。
　
　
　……と見込むのは、まだ早計であろうが。

en.html:
Straight through to Oyumi. Too much convenience I had expected.

The coastal road had let us this far in, then stopped being helpful. An Oyumi army squad had blocked it halfway through Mihama. Beyond that, no passage.

Still ten-odd kilometers to the Kubo headquarters.

ja.html:
やはり小弓まで真っ直ぐ、というのは虫が良過ぎた。
　ここまで侵入を許してくれた沿岸の道路は美浜の中
ほどで小弓軍の一分隊に封鎖され、その先への通行は
もはや叶わない。

　小弓公方府まではあと十数キロ。

en.html:
See a blockade and immediately turn around? An excellent way to invite questions. Ichijou and I had gone up like ordinary travelers, been sent away as expected, and were now walking in the wrong direction.

Continue like this, and we would successfully arrive back in Urayasu. Our disguise would be perfect. Two people who had no business in Oyumi, demonstrating it by leaving. The enemy could only approve.

Unfortunately, making the enemy comfortable was not the operation. We needed some arrangement by which we appeared to go away without achieving quite so much actual going away.

と一条はそのまま単なる通行人を装って近付き、当然
のように追い払われて、今は進路を逆にしている。
　このまま歩き続ければ浦安まで戻ってしまうが。

The location was meant to catch beachgoers. This season, nobody much to catch. Still, the place seemed to be open.

For sitting down and working out what to do, it would suit us well.
